visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a black t-shirt sits at a dark metal mesh table in a sunny outdoor park. He appears extremely distressed, rubbing his eyes and holding his head with both hands. His facial expressions are exaggeratedly pained. Yellow and white captions appear at the bottom. (2) He looks up and squints intensely, shielding his eyes with his right hand as if blinded by a strong light source. In the shaded background, a woman wearing a white tank top and blue denim skirt walks across the green grass. (3) A woman wearing a tiara, sunglasses, and a brown t-shirt suddenly appears in the frame. She holds a pink plastic magic wand and points it toward the man with a dramatic flourish. The background shows a paved path. (4) The woman hands a pair of large, square-framed sunglasses to the man. The man’s facial expression shifts from pained distress to wide-eyed curiosity and amazement. He holds the glasses in his hands, looking at them closely under daylight. (5) Several close-up shots highlight the sunglasses' physical details, including the logo on the corner of the lens and the twisted metal design of the temples. The man is shown touching the frames, which have a gradient tint. (6) The man, now wearing the sunglasses, walks confidently toward the camera through the park. He adjusts his hair and strikes various poses. Rapid editing transitions and colorful, sparkling graphic overlays are used to enhance the sense of transformation. (7) He approaches the woman seen earlier and taps her on the shoulder. She turns around, now also wearing a pair of sunglasses. They look at each other with flirtatious expressions and walk away together along the path. (8) The video concludes with a split-screen montage showing both characters posing together. Final close-ups of the product are shown alongside promotional slogans and brand text in Chinese and English. The lighting remains bright and natural throughout.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A somber, slow piano melody with a melancholic mood plays as the video opens. A male voice speaks in a distressed, low-pitched, and slightly raspy tone, sighing audibly. The speech rate is slow with frequent, heavy pauses indicating sadness. (2) A sharp, magical sparkle sound effect triggers a transition. A female voice speaks with high energy, a bright tone, and a fast pace, acting as a narrator. The background music shifts to a light, bubbly synthesizer track with a faster tempo. (3) An energetic, high-tempo electronic pop track with a strong rhythmic beat begins. Short whoosh transition sound effects and percussive hits are heard between rapid edits. The female voice continues her promotional delivery with high vocal arousal and clarity. (4) The upbeat electronic background music continues. A male voice returns, now speaking in a deeper, more confident, and casual tone. Short laughter and a excited exclamation are heard. Low-level ambient noise of footsteps on a hard surface is audible. (5) A clear, professional male voice provides a closing narration. The speech is well-enunciated with a moderate rate. The upbeat background music maintains a consistent volume before fading out with a final melodic flourish and a soft digital click effect.
